Hi all,

We're finalizing the interview panel for the PM candidate (Priya Reddy) for BrightMetrics. Candidate has very limited availability next week (two half-days only) and recruiting is asking we lock a full slate today so we can send invites.

High-level ask: can folks volunteer to own one of the panels below or swap if there are conflicts? If you take a slot, I'll add you to the calendar and share the debrief template.

Available slots (PST):
- Tue 5/12 09:00–09:45 — Product sense + roadmap (45m)
- Tue 5/12 10:15–11:00 — Technical empathy / architecture (45m)
- Tue 5/12 11:30–12:15 — Behavioral / leadership (45m)
- Tue 5/12 13:15–14:00 — Cross-functional collaboration (45m)

Attachments: PRIYA_REDDY_SLOTS_v1.csv (candidate availability / buffer times).

Priority: we need coverage across product thinking, tech sense, and leadership. If you're booked but can swap, call out which slot you'd take instead.

Thanks — appreciate quick replies.

—Priyom
